_comment: content10h design_final (3 Nov 2026): the final 10-hour content design for docs/content-10h/report.md and change-list.md. The systems design's economy with the player design's warmth, every judge's must-fix applied. ONE file holds every phase; each block carries a 'phase' tag and --phase N (= --set content.max_phase=N) runs the build that ships phase N: 1 = before the soft launch (Izzat, recipe stars, salaam, NH 19, NH 44 South); 2 = first update (Highway Hotel on every highway, Warm welcome perk, dhaba decor); 3 = after D7-D30 data (NH 66, NH 16, festival weeks, counter looks); 4 = reserve only (NH 3, NH 27, with advisers; never part of the headline). Money in ref units (x10 on screen). No economy number outside 'content' is changed: the offline rule stays 1/4 of the takings for up to 2 h, x2 with the ad (data/economy_v3.json:910-917). Run with tools/sim/content10h.py (the merged prototype); every key here is documented in its header.

content._ladder_comment: Prices x1.5 a move (location mult measured from NH 44, code-map §1.5; x2 Family Dhaba on top). cost_mult = the highway's cost dial on every dialled post-tutorial cost (the game: difficulty_cost_mult() x the location's cost_mult, game.gd:1575-1576; never cashiers, the renovation, hotel or decor). It is 1.6-2.4x the price multiplier, so part of it is cost stretching; report §4.3 shows what it adds (XD20). It outgrows prices overall (price / cost with the x2: 3.0 at NH 48, 1.1-1.2 at NH 19 and NH 44 South, 0.84-0.85 from NH 66), so later highways stay at 51-83 bot minutes instead of shrinking to the 6-10 of pitch_v0 (systems.md §4.2); but not at every step (x4 into NH 19 and x2.2 into NH 66, against x1.4 into NH 44 South and x1.5 into NH 16), so NH 44 South is shorter than NH 19 and NH 16 shorter than NH 66 (report.md §3.2). Moves: about 7 minutes of takings without the hotel, 2-6 with it. Move rule: all 16 dishes and, from phase 2, the hotel done (hotel_done holds on a highway with no hotel). NH 48 keeps today's numbers (cost dial 1.0, move 25,000). Hotel overrides (opening, room and tier costs) follow the cost dial: x max(1, cost_mult / mult), rounded.

hotel._comment: Highway Hotel (phase 2, first update): an add-on module, never a third layout (code-map §2.6 option B). Rooms upstairs on a storey over the rear block, behind the signboard's braces (x 1.0-9.0, z -1.9 to -3.3), so no camera or traffic-edge change and no dhaba_v3.glb change (code-map §2.3; report §4.4; render check first). Opens when every counter is at L50, so it runs beside the climb to L100. 2 rooms come with it, 8 in all; 5 looks: charpai on the roof, charpai with net and durrie, cot under a tin shade, room with a door and a fan, lodge room with a cooler. The first room on a highway to reach a look counts as new (tier_new); later rooms reaching it do not. A night's guests = 0.35 x the travellers a minute (the signboard raises it), filling the best rooms first. Paid at dawn of each 600 s day cycle. Done = 8 rooms at the 5th look. No staff, no cleaning, no closed hours, no extra travellers. One offline rule with the dhaba: 1/4 for up to 2 h, x2 with the ad. Not in the reward rate (ads, cards and the chest stay sized on the dhaba).

izzat._comment: Izzat (respect on the highway): permanent, never sold, never reset by a move or an update, never 'sacrificed', spent only on perks. Every award is keyed (highway + goal, slot + tier, week, festival, date) so it pays once. Old saves get a back-grant. No award or toast before the tutorial ends. Daily salaam: the first session of a calendar day, 1 Izzat per dhaba left behind, at most 3 a morning, no streak, keyed by date (anti-clock: max_seen). No offline perk. Good name has 30 levels; every level that can act is owned at 78:37 of play, day 119 for a 5 x 8 player (run P1_100h; XD22). lock_idle_perks: Old staff, Savings and Known face act only at a reset, so they are locked (the bot skips them) while no reset they apply on is still ahead ('Works at your next highway', report §4.1).

old_staff.name: Old staff: start each new dhaba with one more waiter

savings.name: Savings: start each new dhaba with 500 x its price multiplier a level

good_name.name: Good name: +3 % on every price a level (30 levels)

quick_hands.name: Quick hands: cooks 4 % faster a level

fast_feet.name: Fast feet: waiters 4 % faster a level

known_face.name: Known face: start each new highway with the signboard one level up

warm_welcome.name: Warm welcome: the hotel pays 8 % more a level

mastery._comment: Recipe stars: one track per counter menu slot (16), counted across highways, so a move strands nothing; back-granted from dish_counts. 10 tiers; a slot's tier needs threshold x counter factor x slot factor serves, so slots do not cross tiers together. The slot-1 chai track starts with the tutorial's chai (the game counts them); a star they earn is held until the tutorial ends. Each star: +1 Izzat, +1 % on that slot's dish price; +0.5 % on the counter per set level (the lowest star count of its 4 slots). In the game the per-star 1 % goes per dish in dish_price() and price_mean() (game.gd:1109-1110, 1121-1135), like the daily special; the set bonus sits next to fame_mult() in _price_at() (game.gd:1363); neither goes inside dish_eff(). This prototype models the star part as one counter-wide mix-weighted factor (billed per dish the money differs by -0.32 % at 2 bot hours and +0.02 % at 12: report §4.2).

festivals._comment: Festival week (phase 3), one of about 6 a year, rotated, on the baraat machinery. Placed on days 10-16 for the 15-day check only: real dates come from a yearly table. Guests by bus, capped by free seats; steps at 25 / 60 / 120 guests (about 50 minutes of play at 2.4 a minute, so a 2 x 10 min player finishes on day 3 of 7); cash 2 / 4 / 6 minutes of takings; Izzat 2 / 3 / 3; one permanent keepsake at step 2. A baraat weekend inside the window counts toward the festival. No leaderboard, no pass, no ad needed.
festivals.name: festival week

counter_looks._comment: Phase 3: a counter's look changes at L150, L200, L250 and L300 (levels that exist today, data/economy_v3.json:16-26); new the first time per highway per counter.

decor._comment: Dhaba decor (phase 2): 8 cosmetic items kept on every move (marigold strings, fairy-light canopy, brass samovar, painted charpais, truck-art panels, water cooler, neem chabutra, lit name board), each on its own wall, roof, gate, counter or seat spot, never a floor obstacle (report §4.8); costs never take the cost dial. On sale once the current hotel is done; item k costs base x 2^k x the price multiplier; +1 % on every price each. The cash goal after the counters reach L300.
